parent_company.value: Wipro Enterprises Private Limited — the 2013 demerger of Wipro Limited's non-IT businesses, predominantly owned by Azim Premji, his associates and Premji family charitable trusts; lighting is one of its sectors

product_portfolio.value: Fast-moving consumer goods, lighting, hydraulic cylinders, industrial automation, 3D printing, aerospace component manufacturing and industrial water treatment; in lighting, the Garnet consumer range of LED bulbs, battens, panels and emergency lamps alongside professional luminaires under Wipro Lighting

market_coverage.value: Pan-India, with a genuine second-tier presence in South India where Wipro's Bangalore base gives it dealer depth; in AP and Telangana it is stocked widely in electrical shops and is strong on e-commerce and its own D2C store

quality_strength_note.value: Wipro sells the Garnet range on electrical robustness rather than photometrics: LM-80 tested LEDs so brightness holds over life, a 240° beam for wide glare-free spread, a 100-300 V AC operating window and 400 V high-voltage plus 4 kV surge protection — a good fit for feeders that swing

engineer_user_rating.value: 4.1/5 (typical) — well regarded for surviving voltage fluctuation, less so for published photometric detail

contractor_preference.value: Moderate to high. Often the value pick when a contractor wants a national brand at a lower landed cost than Philips or Havells

novice_preference.value: High. The Wipro name carries trust from consumer care products, so a first-time buyer accepts it without checking the specification

project_vs_retail_cost_note.value: Wipro's own D2C store price for the 9 W bulb sits far below printed MRP, which sets a low reference for retail; project supply is negotiated per carton and lands lower again

bulk_discount_note.value: Carton and multi-carton slabs are the usual mechanism; combination orders with battens and panels get the better rate

dealer_margin_note.value: Roughly 20-30 % at the counter on LED bulbs, with the brand's own online pricing capping what a dealer can hold

primary_use.value: General indoor lighting in homes — bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens and passages

secondary_use.value: Small offices, shops and workshops running on existing B22 holders

special_use.value: Locations with poor supply quality, where the 100-300 V operating window and 400 V protection matter more than the last few lumens

short_description: Wipro Garnet 9 W B22 LED bulb, 900 lm cool day white 6500 K, 240° spread, works from 100-300 V AC with 4 kV surge protection.
long_description:
## What it is

The Wipro Garnet 9 W B22 Cool Day White LED bulb (catalogue number N96101) is the 9-watt bayonet-cap node of Wipro's mainstream Garnet household LED range. It is a round A-shape lamp in a polycarbonate body with a frosted diffuser and a B22 cap, and it puts out 900 lumens of 6500 K cool day white — about 100 lumens per watt.

## What it's for

Everyday indoor lighting: bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens, passages, and small offices and shops running on existing B22 holders. Wipro sells it for home and office use, and the carton restricts it to indoor applications. At 900 lm it is a like-for-like replacement for an ordinary incandescent bulb in the same holder.

## Key specifications

Rated 220-240 V AC at 50 Hz, the lamp is built around a wide operating window: it keeps running from 100 V to 300 V AC, carries 400 V high-voltage protection and 4 kV of surge protection, which is the reason to reach for it on a feeder that swings. The LEDs are LM-80 tested so the brightness holds over the lamp's life, and the 240° beam gives a wide, glare-free spread rather than a narrow pool. The carton declares base cap B22, IS 16102 (Part 1) with the BIS standard mark, no UV or IR radiation, non-dimmable operation, and net quantity 1 N. The lamp is made in India by Wipro Enterprises (P) Ltd.

## Application and installation notes

Push the cap into the B22 holder and twist a quarter turn. It is not dimmable, so keep it off dimmer and regulator circuits. Do not fit it in a totally enclosed fixture — the carton says so explicitly, and a sealed fitting traps the heat the lamp needs to shed. Indoor use only; it has no declared IP rating and is not intended for open verandas or outdoor fittings. Being polycarbonate rather than glass it will survive a knock that would shatter a filament bulb.

## What's in the box

One lamp in a printed Garnet carton, net quantity 1 N, with the catalogue number, base cap, voltage, IS standard, BIS mark and MRP block printed on the declaration panel. Wipro's usual lamp warranty is one year from date of purchase.
